POLICIES
shipping: Ships from the Melbourne warehouse, Monday to Friday. Orders dispatch within 1 to 2 business days of payment clearing. Delivery from dispatch: Melbourne, Sydney and Adelaide 1 to 2 business days; Brisbane 2 to 3 business days; Hobart 3 to 4 business days; Perth 4 to 7 business days. Standard shipping is $12.95 for orders under $200 and free for orders of $200 or more. Express is a flat $15. New Zealand is a flat $20. Orders with more than one carton may arrive as separate deliveries. Someone needs to be home to receive a delivery unless authority to leave has been requested, and delivery is not available to PO boxes or Australia Post parcel lockers.
warranty: Nanit Baby Monitor cameras (Pro camera, with any stand) carry a 2-year Australian warranty. Every other product type, accessories, stands bought separately, the Sound Machine, Flex Stand, Travel Case and Breathing Wear, carries a 1-year Australian warranty. Warranty covers products bought from an authorised Australian retailer and does not cover misuse, accidental damage, unauthorised repair, incorrect installation, issues caused by the customer's own Wi-Fi or internet, or normal wear on consumable parts. To claim, start a request through the support portal or call (lodge a request instead) with the order number and a description of the fault; Nanit Australia will repair, replace or refund at its discretion. Australian Consumer Law guarantees apply on top of this warranty and cannot be excluded.
returns: 30 days from the date of delivery to return an item, provided it is unused and in its original packaging. Start a return through the support portal or by calling (lodge a request instead).

PRODUCT NOTES
Nanit Smart Baby Pro Monitor with Floor Stand for Nursery Setup (https://nanit.com.au/products/nanit-smart-baby-pro-monitor-with-floor-stand-for-nursery-setup): The most chosen Australian setup. No drilling, freestanding floor stand positions the camera at the ideal overhead angle beside the cot, and it moves with you if you rearrange the room or move house. Suits a nursery or a rental.
Nanit Smart Baby Pro Monitor with Wall Mount for Fixed Nursery Setup (https://nanit.com.au/products/nanit-smart-baby-pro-monitor-with-wall-mount-for-fixed-nursery-setup): The most permanent, cleanest-looking setup: the camera mounts directly above the cot. Needs two wall anchors (drilling required), best for a long-term nursery rather than a rental.
Nanit Smart Baby Monitor with Flex Stand for Travel & Multi-Room Use (https://nanit.com.au/products/nanit-smart-baby-monitor-with-flex-stand-for-travel-multi-room-use): The portable option. The flexible, bendable stand clips to a cot rail, shelf or table edge, no drilling and no separate floor stand needed, so it is easy to move between rooms or take travelling.
Nanit Smart Baby Sound Machine & Night Light for Better Sleep (https://nanit.com.au/products/nanit-smart-baby-sound-machine-night-light-for-better-sleep): A standalone sound machine and night light, not a camera. Pairs with the Nanit app for white noise, nightlight control and routines; works alongside a Nanit camera or on its own.
Nanit Breathing Wear (Bands and Pyjamas) (https://nanit.com.au/products/nanit-breathing-wear-band-small-for-baby-breathing-motion-monitoring): Required for breathing motion monitoring to work: a swaddle, band or pyjama with a printed pattern the camera reads from above. Nothing is worn on the body and no sensor touches the baby. Sold in Newborn, 3 Month, Small, Medium and Large sizes; buy the next size as your baby grows.
Nanit Travel Case for Baby Monitor (https://nanit.com.au/products/nanit-travel-case-for-baby-monitor-green): A padded case sized for the Nanit camera and Flex Stand, for travel or moving the setup between rooms. Available in green or grey.

FAQ
Q: Is Nanit a medical device?
A: No. Nanit is not a medical device and is not intended to diagnose, treat, monitor or prevent any medical condition, including SIDS. Always follow recommended safe sleep practices.
Q: Is the Australian model different to the US or UK version?
A: The camera itself is identical to the global Nanit Pro. Australian units ship with an AU power adapter, a warranty backed locally, and are supported directly by the Coolkidz Melbourne team on (lodge a request instead).
Q: Does Nanit work without Wi-Fi?
A: The camera keeps recording and working on the local network if the internet drops, so you can still see and hear your baby at home. Remote viewing, alerts and Nanit Insights resume once you reconnect.
Q: How does Nanit track breathing without touching my baby?
A: The camera reads the pattern on Nanit Breathing Wear, a swaddle, sleeping bag or pyjama with a printed pattern on the front. Nothing is worn on the body and no sensors touch the baby.
Q: Do I need to buy Breathing Wear separately?
A: Yes, breathing motion monitoring needs at least one piece of compatible Breathing Wear. Most complete Nanit systems include one to start, and more sizes can be bought as the baby grows.
Q: What is the difference between Nanit and a wearable sock monitor?
A: Wearable monitors clip a sensor to the baby's foot to estimate heart rate and oxygen. Nanit instead reads breathing motion from above using the camera and the Breathing Wear pattern, with nothing attached to the baby's body.
Q: Does Nanit need a subscription to work?
A: No. Live HD video, two-way audio, breathing motion monitoring and instant alerts all work without a plan. Nanit Insights adds sleep analytics, extended video history and personalised guidance, and is included free with every camera for the first 3 months.
Q: What happens after my 3 months of Nanit Insights ends?
A: The camera, live view, alerts and breathing motion monitoring keep working exactly as before. You can continue Nanit Insights on a paid plan to keep sleep analytics and extended video history, or keep using the core features at no extra cost.
Q: What does NextNap do?
A: NextNap predicts a baby's next nap window from their own sleep data, instead of a generic age-based schedule. It needs an active Nanit Insights plan and a compatible camera.
Q: Can more than one person use the app?
A: Yes. Other caregivers, such as a partner, grandparent or nanny, can be invited to the Parenting Team so everyone can view the camera and, on higher Insights plans, see sleep and care history.
Q: Do I need to drill for the Wall Mount?
A: Yes, the Wall Mount fixes above the cot for the cleanest, most permanent view and needs two wall anchors. The Floor Stand and Flex Stand need no drilling at all.
Q: Which setup do most Australian parents choose?
A: Pro + Floor Stand is the most chosen configuration: no drilling, works in a nursery or a rental, and moves with you if you rearrange the room.
Q: My camera won't connect to Wi-Fi, what should I try first?
A: Confirm the home network is 2.4GHz (Nanit does not connect to 5GHz-only networks), move the camera within range of the router during setup, and restart both the camera and router before trying again. If it still won't connect, use the support portal for step-by-step help.
Q: How much does shipping cost?
A: Standard shipping is free on orders of $200 or more, and a flat $12.95 under that. Express shipping is a flat $15. New Zealand ships for a flat $20.
Q: How long does delivery take?
A: Orders dispatch from the Melbourne warehouse within 1 to 2 business days. From there, most capital cities receive their order in 1 to 3 business days; Perth typically takes 4 to 7 business days.
Q: What is your returns policy?
A: 30 days from the date of delivery to return an item, provided it is unused and in its original packaging. Start a return through the support portal.
Q: How do I start a warranty claim?
A: Nanit Baby Monitor cameras carry a 2-year Australian warranty; every other product carries 1 year. Start a claim through the support portal or call the Melbourne team on (lodge a request instead), and they will confirm whether a repair, replacement or refund applies.

Q: Is Gaia Baby furniture made from MDF or particleboard?

Q: Are Gaia Baby products independently tested?
A: Yes. Furniture is INPAA Approved and independently tested to meet and exceed Australian safety standards, with finishes tested for heavy metals and toxic compounds. The Stretchy Baby Wrap is certified to PD CEN/TR 16512:2015, BS EN 13209-2:2005 and related EN safety standards, see the product's Safety Standards accordion for the full list.
Q: What's the difference between Hera, Eos and Serena?
A: Hera is the heirloom upper tier in ash and walnut, from $899. Eos is the accessible real-wood range in New Zealand pine with a customisable colour palette, from $749. Serena is the patented 8-in-1 convertible system in birch, one frame from newborn bedside crib to a junior bed at 7+ years, from $1,199.
Q: What's included in a nursery bundle?
A: Each range has a nursery bundle pairing the cot bed with its matching dresser (and changing station where relevant) at a bundled price, see the Hera, Serena and Eos bundle pages under Shop. Furniture ships in multiple labelled boxes (and a separate mattress box where included); this is normal for flat-packed solid-wood pieces.
Q: Does the Stretchy Baby Wrap contain elastane?
A: No, it's 100% certified organic cotton with no elastane or synthetic blends, designed to be breathable and supportive without excess stretch.
Q: What size wrap do I need?
A: The Stretchy Baby Wrap is one size fits all, suitable from newborn to approximately 15 kg, worn front-facing-in.

WonderFold.facts:
RANGE
shared: Every WonderFold stroller wagon has raised, reclining, removable seats with padded 5-point harnesses, a removable UPF 50+ canopy on adjustable poles, a front zip door, mesh sides and a roll-out wind/privacy shade, pockets on every side and a rear basket, a one-step foot brake (red on AU models), an optional pull strap, and folds to stand on its own. Suitable from 6 months in the seats, or from birth with a compatible infant capsule on the W2 or W4 car seat adapter. Every model and finish sold in Australia is certified to AS 2088:2022 / A1:2024, the Australian standard for prams and strollers. One honest price, no was prices.
W2: Two seats. Best for most families with two children: lighter, shorter, easier in shop aisles and smaller boots. 91 kg total. W2 Elite $1,299 (Charcoal Grey, Volcanic Black), 25 kg, 20 kg per seat. W2 Luxe $1,399 (Volcanic Black, Charcoal Grey), 24 kg, 20 kg per seat. W2 Luxe Pro $1,499 (Jet Black), 22.3 kg, 22 kg per seat, 76.2 cm at its widest.
W4: Four seats on two benches. For three or four children, or two with another on the way. 136 kg total, 45 kg per bench, 74 cm at its widest, inside 84 x 53 cm. W4 Elite $1,499 (Volcanic Black, Charcoal Grey), 26.3 kg. W4 Luxe $1,799 (Volcanic Black, Charcoal Grey), weight to be confirmed. W4 Luxe Pro $1,999 (Jet Black), 24.5 kg, folded 113 x 74 x 51 cm.
W6: Six seats on three benches, Luxe Pro only, $1,999 (Jet Black), 31.8 kg, 140 kg total, 45 kg per bench, 74 cm wide, dual faux-leather handlebars. For big families, multiples and early-learning groups. No AU car seat adapter for the W6 yet.
finishes: Elite: all-terrain EVA wheels, neoprene handlebar cover, padded 5-point harness; XL wheels can be added later ($379). Luxe: all-terrain XL wheels with suspension, vegan-leather handlebar, magnetic 5-point harness, extra front pocket. Luxe Pro: lighter aluminium frame, seats that can face forward or face the parent, lockable front wheels, faux-leather handlebar, insulated rear cooler basket (5 kg cooler, 1 kg mesh).
volkswagen: W4 Volkswagen special edition in Bondi Blue, $1,999, four seats, VW bumper, working headlights, retro XL wheels. An online exclusive: only sold at wonderfold.com.au, not through Baby Bunting or other retailers. Currently out of stock. Its frame material, weight and folded size are not confirmed: never say it shares the Luxe Pro's aluminium frame or state its weight.
not_sizes: Folded sizes for the W2, W6, Elite and Luxe are being confirmed; do not guess them.
discontinued: The WonderFold pet stroller has been discontinued in Australia and is no longer sold. Don't suggest putting pets in the stroller wagons.

CHOOSING
Choose size first, then finish. One child: most families do not need a wagon; W2 if they carry a lot. Two children: W2, unless another baby is likely soon (then W4). Three or four: W4. Five or six, multiples or early-learning groups: W6. Finish by where they walk: footpaths and shops suit Elite; beach, grass and gravel suit Luxe or Luxe Pro (XL wheels); babies under 12 months suit Luxe Pro (seats can face you). Under 6 months: a compatible capsule on the car seat adapter. Before buying, measure the boot: a folded W4 Luxe Pro is 113 x 74 x 51 cm.

ACCESSORIES
Car seat adapter for W2 or W4, $189.95; compatible capsules: Maxi-Cosi Mico 6, Mico 12 and AP/Plus, Joie i-Gemm, Nuna Pipa, Cybex Cloud Q. Flex Canopy W2 or W4 $199.95. All Terrain XL Wheels $379. W4 single seat $127.45 (frees floor space). Weather, wind, winter, rain and travel covers, shadenets, mosquito nets, snack trays, all-weather mats, shopping baskets, pram organisers and a cup and phone holder. Only recommend accessories that appear in the live product list.

POLICIES
shipping: StarTrack Express shipping Australia-wide: $12.95 on orders under $100, free on orders of $100 or more (every wagon ships free). Free pickup from 1 Beyer Road, Braeside VIC, usually ready within 24 hours. Same-day delivery in selected Melbourne areas (see the same-day delivery terms page).
returns: Australian Consumer Law always applies. Faulty or wrong item: tell us within 48 hours of delivery; we issue a return authority within 1 to 2 working days, then replace, repair or refund. Change of mind: exchange or store credit within 7 days of purchase, unused, unopened, in original packaging with proof of purchase. Not eligible: gift cards, clearance and special orders. Do not send items back without a return authority.
warranty: One-year manufacturer warranty on every wagon. To make a warranty claim or order spare parts, lodge a support ticket with the Coolkidz help desk at https://help.coolkidz.com.au/support/tickets/new (always link this help desk URL for claims, not the registration page), including the order number, the model and photos or a short video of the issue. Faulty on arrival: lodge a ticket within 48 hours of delivery. In warranty, the team repairs or replaces; out of warranty, it quotes spare parts (wheels, brakes, canopy poles and fabric, seats). Register within three months of purchase for a one-time 10% off accessories code: for now, register by emailing (lodge a request instead) with your name, contact details, model, serial number, purchase date, retailer and a photo of the receipt (an online form is coming).

FAQ
Q: Will a WonderFold fit through a doorway?
A: Yes. The W4 and W6 are 74 cm at their widest and the W2 Luxe Pro 76.2 cm, which fits a standard Australian internal door.
Q: How do I clean it?
A: Wipe the frame with a soft towel, lukewarm water and a mild cleaner, then dry. Rinse dirt off the wheels. Spot clean the fabric with mild soap and warm water and air dry.
Q: Is it a medical device?
A: No. WonderFold stroller wagons are not medical devices or mobility aids. Many families with children who have additional needs choose one for its space and easy entry.
Q: Can it go on sand?
A: Hard, packed sand near the water is fine, especially with XL wheels (Luxe and Luxe Pro); soft dry sand is hard work for any wagon. The included pull strap helps on rough ground.
Q: Where is my order?
A: Check the dispatch email for tracking, or call (lodge a request instead) with the order number.

Heka L: Flagship. Telescopic and wide-bodied for maximum capacity. 40L capacity, holds approx. 45 nappies. 28.5 × 63cm (W×H). From $149.95. Ships with bin only. 2nd-life bathroom lid available, $34.95. 7 colourways.
shared_mechanism: All three ranges use the same wave-seal, drop-and-turn mechanism and work with any standard bin liner, or Magic's own bag for a guaranteed seal. Nothing about how the seal works changes between ranges, the difference is size, footprint and price.
material: 100% recycled polypropylene (PP), GRS-traceable material, across the whole range.
nappy_capacity_caveat: Nappy capacity depends on nappy size, the figures above are approximate, based on newborn/infant sizing. Expect fewer nappies per bin as the baby (and their nappies) grow.

CHOOSING
If floor space isn't a constraint and maximum capacity matters most (fewer bag changes), Heka L is the biggest. For a tight bathroom or nursery, Thoth has the same telescopic height as Heka but a slimmer 24cm footprint. For the lowest entry price and a compact fixed-height bin, Majestic is the starter option, though it doesn't have the 2nd-life bathroom lid.

ACCESSORIES
Bathroom lid accessory ($34.95) converts a Heka or Thoth base into a regular household bin once nappies are done, not available for Majestic. Magic's own nappy bags are designed for a guaranteed seal on any Magic bin and can help lock in odour for up to two weeks when used correctly.

HOW IT WORKS
Drop the nappy through the top opening, no bag threading, no touching the waste. Turn the lid to seal the wave seal shut behind it, locking odour into the chamber below. When the bag is full, use the small release button, turn and lift the top section off together with the bag, twist the bag a few times to seal it, then slide it out and dispose as usual.

CARE
Unscrew the drum holder and remove the round drum. Hand-wash all parts in lukewarm water with a few tablespoons of baking soda and a little mild soap. Don't put any part in the dishwasher, rinse and air-dry fully before reassembling.

TROUBLESHOOTING
smells: Check three things in order: the liner is free of holes and installed correctly (use a standard bag or an official Magic bag, thinner supermarket bags may not seal properly), the lid is closed fully after every use, and the bin is left in stand-by position (cup open, not rounded-side-up).
wont_open: Use the small release button to release the top. Turn it and lift the top section off together with the bag, then twist the bag a few times to seal it before sliding it out.

POLICIES
shipping: Orders typically leave the Braeside, Melbourne warehouse within 1 to 2 business days (longer during sales/promos/holidays). Standard delivery from dispatch: Melbourne/Sydney/Adelaide 1 to 2 business days, Brisbane 2 to 3 business days, Hobart 3 to 4 business days, Perth 4 to 7 business days. Multi-item orders may ship in separate cartons with separate tracking. No authority-to-leave unless specified, and Australia Post parcel lockers aren't supported.
returns: 30 days to return, from date of receipt. Start a return at help.coolkidz.com.au.
warranty: 1 year warranty, backed by Coolkidz Australia, on top of Australian Consumer Law rights (which can't be excluded, major failures get a replacement or refund). Covers normal use for its intended purpose, maintained per the manual, with valid dated proof of purchase and genuine Magic parts. Does not cover normal wear and tear, sun/heat/moisture damage, accidental damage, misuse, overloading, transport damage, or consequential loss. To claim: lodge a ticket at help.coolkidz.com.au with proof of purchase, a description of the issue and photos/video.

Labour & Delivery Kit (Hospital Birth Kit, https://fridaaustralia.com.au/products/frida-mom-hospital-labor-delivery-kit): Labour & Delivery Gown (one size XS to XL, snap shoulders for skin-to-skin), labour socks, toiletry carry bag, Upside Down Peri Bottle, 4 disposable underwear, 4 Instant Ice Maxi Pads, witch hazel cooling liners, Perineal Foam, bathroom caddy. Covers labour, delivery and the first week of postpartum care.
Postpartum Recovery Kit (https://fridaaustralia.com.au/products/frida-mom-postpartum-recovery-kit): 4 disposable underwear, 4 Instant Ice Maxi Pads, witch hazel cooling liners, Perineal Foam, bathroom caddy. It does NOT include the peri bottle or the gown; the peri bottle is sold separately, or choose the Labour & Delivery Kit which includes it. Suits recovery at home after any type of birth.
Quantities: Both kits contain 4 disposable underwear and 4 Instant Ice Maxi Pads. You do not have the count of cooling liners or the foam size: if asked, say so plainly and point to the contact page rather than guessing.

FAQ
Q: Is the NoseFrida suitable for newborns?
A: Yes, suitable from birth. The tube sits against the outside of the nostril, never inside, and the parent controls the suction. Use saline drops first and suction gently. If a newborn has persistent congestion, difficulty breathing or a fever, see a GP or child health nurse.
Q: Will I get mucus in my mouth?
A: No. A disposable hygiene filter sits between the collection chamber and the mouthpiece and is designed to stop mucus travelling toward the mouth. Replace the filter after every use.
Q: How do I use it?
A: 1. Insert a fresh filter. 2. Saline drops in each nostril, wait 20 to 30 seconds. 3. Rest the blue tube against the outside of the nostril to make a seal. 4. Breathe in gently through the red mouthpiece with a small circular motion. 5. Repeat on the other side. 6. Disassemble, bin the filter, wash the parts (top rack dishwasher safe; clear tube with 70% isopropyl alcohol). Full guide: https://fridaaustralia.com.au/blogs/baby-care-guides/how-to-use-the-nosefrida-the-complete-australian-guide
Q: How often can I use it?
A: As often as needed, typically before feeds and before sleep during a cold. It is non-invasive and parent-controlled. Congestion lasting more than ten days, or with fever or breathing difficulty, needs a GP.
Q: How often do I replace filters?
A: After every use. Filters are single-use for hygiene and suction. Replacement packs of 20: https://fridaaustralia.com.au/products/frida-baby-nosefrida-filters
Q: My baby cries when I use it. Am I doing it wrong?
A: Almost certainly not. Crying is normal, it is an unusual sensation rather than a painful one. A second person holding baby's arms helps. It stops as soon as you finish.
Q: What is the MediFrida?
A: A dummy-shaped medicine dispenser. Measure the dose into the syringe, attach it to the dummy, and press slowly as baby sucks so the liquid goes to the side of the cheek. Follow the dose your pharmacist or doctor gives. https://fridaaustralia.com.au/products/frida-baby-medifrida
Q: What is the Flake Fixer for?
A: Cradle cap. Three steps in the bath: lather with the sponge, loosen with the silicone brush, lift flakes with the fine-tooth comb. A couple of times a week. If the scalp is red, weeping or not improving, see a GP or child health nurse.
Q: What is in the SnipperClipper Set?
A: Baby nail clippers with a safety guard and built-in magnifier, plus a nail file, for very small fingers and toes.
Q: When do I start dental care?
A: The Fingerbrush is for gums and first teeth from birth. The ToothHugger is a triple-sided toothbrush for toddlers. Australian dental guidance is to start brushing when the first tooth appears.
Q: Which kit should I buy?
A: Packing a hospital bag and want everything in one order: the Labour & Delivery Kit (includes gown, socks, carry bag and peri bottle). Already have a gown and want recovery items for home: the Postpartum Recovery Kit (no peri bottle or gown). Buying both together gets 10% off the Recovery Kit in cart.
Q: Are the kits suitable after a caesarean?
A: Yes. Lochia (postpartum bleeding) happens after every birth, so the peri bottle, ice pads, liners and underwear are all still relevant. For an incision, add the High Waist Disposable Underwear, which sits above the scar (https://fridaaustralia.com.au/products/frida-mom-disposable-high-waist-underwear). Guide: https://fridaaustralia.com.au/blogs/postpartum-guides/c-section-recovery-in-australia-what-to-expect-in-the-first-six-weeks
Q: How do the ice pads work?
A: Bend to activate, no freezer needed. Cooling comfort for the first 72 hours, and they are a full absorbent maternity pad as well. https://fridaaustralia.com.au/products/frida-mom-instant-ice-maxi-pads
Q: How do I use the foam and liners?
A: Place a witch hazel cooling liner along your maternity pad, add one pump of Perineal Foam on top, replace with every pad change. Cooling comfort for perineal swelling and postpartum haemorrhoids.
Q: Why a peri bottle?
A: Rinsing with warm water after every toilet visit instead of wiping in the first weeks. The upside-down angled nozzle reaches without contortion. Useful after vaginal and caesarean births. https://fridaaustralia.com.au/products/frida-mom-peri-bottle
Q: Boyshort or high waist?
A: Boyshort suits vaginal birth recovery. High waist sits above a caesarean incision. Both are soft, stretchy and disposable, and hold pads in place.
Q: Where can I buy Frida in store?
A: Baby Bunting stocks Frida Baby and Frida Mom in around 75 stores nationally, plus independents such as Bubs n Grubs, Baby Kingdom, Baby Village, Kiddie Country, Babyroad and HoneyBaby. Full list by state: https://fridaaustralia.com.au/pages/stockists
Q: Can midwives or clinics get samples?
A: Yes. Health professionals can request a NoseFrida clinic sample and printed handouts through the form at https://fridaaustralia.com.au/pages/health-professionals Printable A5 patient handouts for every product are at https://fridaaustralia.com.au/pages/patient-handouts

POLICIES

Manufacturer's warranty, 12 months, Against defects in materials and workmanship, from the date of purchase, on every Zazu sold in Australia.
How a claim works Three steps, no forms.
1, Use the contact form with your order number, a photo or short video of the fault, and a sentence on what is happening.
2, We reply within one to two working days with a return authority. Please don't send anything back without one.
3, Pack it up and send it to Coolkidz Australia Pty Ltd, 1 Beyer Road, Braeside VIC 3195. The replacement ships as soon as it lands, and we transfer your return postage.
Questions The fine print, in plain English.
Do I get a refund or a replacement?, In most cases a faulty product is replaced or repaired. If you'd prefer a refund on a faulty item, ask and we'll arrange it.
What isn't covered?, Normal wear, damage from misuse or accidents, and batteries. Change-of-mind returns must be unopened.
My clock is stuck on green, Usually a settings issue, not a fault. Set the wake-up time before bedtime, and use the sleep timer if you need it back to red tonight. If it still misbehaves, get in touch and we'll sort it.
I bought it from a retailer, Go back to the retailer first, as the law requires. If you get stuck, get in touch and we'll help you through it.

FAQ
Q: In short how do I operate Sam or Davy?
A: Please check out our Quickstart video or read the manual. You can also check our how to video’s. It clearly describes the 1st steps to get Sam/Davy up and running. Once the settings are done, Sam/Davy will close their eyes every day and open them in the morning at preset time.
Q: If the power is turned off , does the sleeptrainer remember it’s settings?
A: When the power shuts off, the sleeptrainer will not remember it’s settings unless batteries are inserted. We therefore advise to insert the batteries as back up in case power shuts off.
Q: How can I stop my child from playing with buttons and changing the settings?
A: The clock will enter key lock mode automatically after 1 minute. To manually activate the key lock: press the key lock button for 3 seconds. After activating the sleeptimer/wake-up time the key-lock is activated straight away, so that the settings cannot be changed anymore.
Q: Can I separate the wake-up time from the alarm time?
A: Yes, when setting the naptime or wake-up time, you can separately set the alarm. So you can set the sound alarm at a later time than the opening of the eyes.
Q: Can I switch off the orange screen, half an hour before wake-up?
A: It is not possible to switch off or change the time it turns on. The time is fixed at 30 minutes. If your child is still sleeping, the orange light will not wake him/her up. But if he/she does wake up, she knows straight away that it is not much longer by seeing the screen is orange.
Q: How can I close Sam’s or Davy’s eyes?
A: In the menu you select a time that Sam/Davy will automatically close their eyes every day. If you want to close them earlier you can press the DOWN button for 3 seconds and the eyes will close.
Q: How can I see if the clock is key-locked?
A: In the top of the LCD screen the key-lock symbol will appear when it is activated.
Q: How do I know if my clock is activated?
A: Sam or Davy is always activated. Once you have set the bedtime and OK to wake up time, he will automatically go to sleep every night and wake up every morning at the preset time.
Q: What if Sam is just not listening at all?
A: Try resetting Sam by pushing the tiny button with a paperclip on the bottom of the clock. This will usually make him listen.
Q: Sometimes the buttons do not react when I press them. What is wrong?
A: Probably the key lock has been activated. To unlock press the keylock-button, right, for 3 sec.
Q: If I do not want the alarm to sound, do I need to change the volume in the settings menu?
A: No, that is not necessary. In the menu (alarm clock icon) you can switch the alarm ON/OFF.
Q: Is there a demo function to show my child the working of Sam?
A: Yes there is a demo function in the settings menu. This demo will go through the entire bedtime ritual in around 20 seconds with preset time, so not the actual time that you have entered. You can check out our how to video for the demo function
Q: How long can I use the sleeptrainer when using batteries?
A: When using batteries, make sure you are using good alkaline batteries. Also we advise you to limit the nightlight to 5 minutes and select lowest brightness in the settings menu. Only then batteries will last around 4 weeks with normal use. With other settings the battery life will be decreased significantly.
Q: I can’t find the off function in the naptimer menu, what can I do?
A: You have to set the naptimer each time you want to use it, so there is not an off function in the menu because it ends automatically.
Q: Is it possible to set two wake up times so we can use a different wake up time for the weekends?
A: No, this is not possible.
Q: What kind of adapter do I need for Sam/Davy?
A: We advise you to use a 5V,1A adapter.
Q: How can I turn on the light?
A: Press the big round ON/OFF button on the bottom.
Q: How do I switch on/off the timer for the nightlight?
A: You can set the 60-minute timer by pressing the small clock and alarm button at the same time. Pam flashes once green when the timer is switched on and red if the timer is switched off.
Q: Can I change the settings for orange and green light?
A: This is not possible. The preset times can not be adjusted.
Q: How do I switch on the wireless connection?
A: Press the clock and triangle button at the same time. The wireless speaker symbol will appear in the display if activated. In the bluetooth menu of your phone, look for ZAZU-PAM and connect.
Q: How long does the wireless speaker stay connected?
A: If you use Pam with the timer, the bluetooth will switch off together with the light. If you use Pam without the timer, the connection stays as long as you are playing music/songs.
Q: Why do I need to reconnect to the wireless speaker?
A: If Pam needs to ‘look’ for connection 24/7 it takes up too much battery.
Q: How do I change the colour of the nightlight?
A: Press the big round button several times to get to your preferred colour.
Q: How do I change the brightness of the nightlight?
A: Switch on the nightlight by pressing the big button, then keep the big button pressed. The brightness will change. Let go at the right brightness. Pam will remember this setting for next use.
Q: How do I use Pam as a nightlight only?
A: Press the triangle button on the bottom for 3 seconds. In the display will appear a crossed out alarm clock. This means that the sleeptraining function is switched off.
Q: What kind of adaptor do I need to use for charging?
A: You can use any 5Volt output adapter for charging. Most telephone adapters comply with this.
Q: HOW DOES THE CRY SENSOR WORK?
A: The cry sensor operates by listening to sounds, such as crying. When it detects a certain level of sound, typically crying, it will activate the rocking. Upon detecting crying, it will rock the stroller for a duration of 10 minutes. The cry sensor will remain active for a continuous period of 3 hours to provide soothing support when needed.
Q: IF THE LED LIGHT IS FLASHING, HOW MUCH TIME REMAINS UNTIL THE PRODUCT IS DEPLETED?
A: When the flashing begins, you can expect approximately 2 more hours of usage, contingent upon the chosen frequency.
Q: CAN YOU I USE THE ROCKER IN THE RAIN?
A: The product has been tested with an IPX1 rating, indicating its resistance to light rain. However, we strongly recommend that when it starts raining, you remove the rocker and store it in a dry place. Please refrain from exposing it to prolonged or heavy rainfall.
Q: CAN I ATTACH THE ROCKER ANYWHERE?
A: The product should always be positioned horizontally and should not be attached to the side bar. The ideal placement is on the main handlebar of the stroller. The farther away it is from the wheel base, the more effective the rocking motion will be.
Q: IS IT POSSIBLE TO KEEP ROBBY RUNNING CONTINUOUSLY?
A: You cannot have Robby on continuously, as the rocker is programmed to automatically switch off after 40 minutes. However, you have the option to activate the cry sensor. When your child remains restless and cries, the cry sensor will automatically switch on the rocker again for an additional 10 minutes to provide soothing comfort.
Q: IN WHAT TEMPERATURE RANGE IS ROBBY SUITABLE FOR USE?
A: Robby is suitable for use in temperatures ranging from 30°C to -10°C. However, please be aware that colder temperatures will result in reduced battery life.
Q: HOW DOES THE CRY SENSOR WORK?
A: The cry sensor operates by listening to sounds, such as crying. When it detects a certain level of sound, typically crying, it will activate the rocking. Upon detecting crying, it will rock the stroller for a duration of 10 minutes. The cry sensor will remain active for a continuous period of 3 hours to provide soothing support when needed.
Q: IF THE LED LIGHT IS FLASHING, HOW MUCH TIME REMAINS UNTIL THE PRODUCT IS DEPLETED?
A: When the flashing begins, you can expect approximately 2 more hours of usage, contingent upon the chosen frequency.
Q: CAN YOU I USE THE ROCKER IN THE RAIN?
A: The product has been tested with an IPX1 rating, indicating its resistance to light rain. However, we strongly recommend that when it starts raining, you remove the rocker and store it in a dry place. Please refrain from exposing it to prolonged or heavy rainfall.
Q: CAN I ATTACH THE ROCKER ANYWHERE?
A: The product should always be positioned horizontally and should not be attached to the side bar. The ideal placement is on the main handlebar of the stroller. The farther away it is from the wheel base, the more effective the rocking motion will be.
Q: IS IT POSSIBLE TO KEEP ROXY RUNNING CONTINUOUSLY?
A: You cannot have Roxy on continuously, as the rocker is programmed to automatically switch off after 40 minutes. However, you have the option to activate the cry sensor. When your child remains restless and cries, the cry sensor will automatically switch on the rocker again for an additional 10 minutes to provide soothing comfort.
Q: IN WHAT TEMPERATURE RANGE IS ROXY SUITABLE FOR USE?
A: Roxy is suitable for use in temperatures ranging from 30°C to -10°C. However, please be aware that colder temperatures will result in reduced battery life.
Q: How do I close Bobby’s eyes?
A: Press the big button on the top for 3 seconds and Bobby’s eyes will close until it is OK to wake up.
Q: Do I need to close the eyes every night?
A: Yes, every night at bedtime you close Bobby’s eyes by pressing the big button on top for 3 seconds.
Q: How do I switch the sound off?
A: Behind the lid on the bottom there is a knob with which you can lower the sound volume or switch off completely.
Q: What power supply does Brody have?
A: Brody works on 3x AA Alkaline batteries.
Q: Is it possible to set two wake up times so we can use a different wake up time for the weekends?
A: No, this is not possible.
Q: How do I use Brody as a nightlight only?
A: If the display does not show the ‘alarm clock’ icon in the left bottom of the display, your Brody is ready for nightlight/soundmachine only. If not follow below steps:
Q: How do I change the brightness of the light?
A: First unlock the key-lock before you can change any settings. Switch on the nightlight by long pressing the shell button. Then press the ‘light bulb’ button until you reach the preferred brightness (HIGH-MEDIUM-LOW-OFF). Check our how to video
Q: How can I turn on the lights?
A: On the front of the nightlight you can find a big button. When you press this button, both the light of the owl/bear and the ring will turn ON. By pressing the OWL/BEAR button, on the left side of the little owl/bear, only the light of the owl/bear will turn ON. When you press the RING button, on the right side of the little owl/bear, only the light of the RING will turn ON.
Q: How can I activate the timer?
A: You can turn on the timer function of the little owl/bear by pressing the OWL/BEAR button for 2 seconds. The owl/bear will flicker when the timer is activated. The timer function of the ring can be turned on by pressing the RING button for 2 seconds. Again, the light of the ring will flicker when the timer is activated.
Q: How long will the lights stay on when the timer is activated?
A: The owl/bear will turn off after 60 minutes and the ring will turn off after 30 minutes.
Q: How can I adjust the brightness of the lights?
A: You can find two sliders on the back of Lou/Billy. By sliding them back and forth you can separately adjust the brightness of the owl/bear and the ring.
Q: How does the cry sensor work?
A: On the back of Lou/Billy there’s a switch with a small ear. Put the switch on ON to activate the cry sensor and switch it to OFF to turn the cry sensor off.
Q: How long will the owl/bear stay on when the sound sensor is activated?
A: When your child is crying the owl/bear will stay on for 5 minutes. After 5 minutes the light will automatically switch off.
Q: How can I turn on the lights?
A: With the ON/OFF button. Press 1x for soft light. Press 2x for bright light. Press 3x to turn it OFF.
Q: After how many minutes does the light turn OFF?
A: The lights will automatically switch off after 60 minutes.
Q: How do I know my Fin is charging?
A: When Fin is charging a small red light will light up. When Fin is fully charged this light will turn green.
Q: How long does it take before Fin is fully charged?
A: The battery is fully charged after 10 hours.
Q: What is the battery life of Fin?
A: A full battery will have a life of around 10 hours.
Q: How do I take off the silicone cover?
A: If you squeeze the silicone cover and grab the light with your other hand, you can pull the cover off. If you know the trick it is easy. We have made it a little difficult so that small children are not able to take off the cover themselves
Q: How long is the battery life?
A: For white light it lasts around 70 hours, for orange it is less around 45 hours. Orange light consumes more power than white.
Q: How does the twilight sensor work?
A: The lights will automatically switch on when it gets dark and off when it turns light.
Q: How can I change the colour of the light?
A: There is a small button on the plug if you take off the cover. Here you choose white or orange light.
Q: Can I switch off the twilight sensor?
A: Yes you can switch off the twilight sensor. The light will then be completely off. To do this take off the cover and set the slider to the OFF position
Q: How long is the battery life?
A: For white light it lasts around 70 hours, for orange it is less around 45 hours. Orange light consumes more power than white.
Q: How can I change the colour of the light?
A: To change the colour of the light, simply tap on the silicone bear and the light will change. Choose from 8 colours.
Q: How do I turn the timer on and off?
A: Double click the button on the bottom. If the timer is ON you see a green light. If the timer is OFF you see a red light near the button
Q: How long is the battery life?
A: You can use Suzy for more than 100 hours on 1 charge.
Q: How can switch on the 20 minute timer?
A: Double press the ON/OFF button. If the green light is on, the timer is active. If the light is red, the timer is inactive and the music will keep playing
Q: How does the cry sensor work?
A: If Suzy detects crying it will automatically play the last song again
Q: Can I have Gaia switch off automatically?
A: Yes, you can automatically switch off after 20 or 40 minutes. Set the slider on the bottom of the module in the right position. Alternatively you can play the entire night
Q: How long does the flash light stay ON?
A: The flash light automatically switches off after 10 minutes. So your child will not sleep with the bright light.
Q: How long does the nightlight stay on?
A: The nightlight switches off after 30 minutes. When Gina is charging, the nightlight can stay on the entire night.
Q: How do I change the colour of the nightlight?
A: Keep the nightlight button pressed and the colours will change. Let go when the preferred colour is showing. Gina will remember the setting for next time use.
Q: How do I switch off the nightlight manually?
A: Press the nightlight button and wait until the light switches OFF. It might take another few colours until you reach the off setting.
Q: Can I use the nightlight without sound?
A: Yes, on the top side of the module you can switch off the sound and use the light only.
Q: How long do the batteries last?
A: Depending on how many times it is activated it should last 4-6 weeks.
Q: How do I change the colour?
A: Tap with your nail on the ring and the colour will change. The light will remember the setting for next use.
Q: How do I change the brightness?
A: Keep your hand fixated underneath the light. As long as your hand is in the beam, the light will slowly dim and get brighter. Take away your hand once the preferred brightness is reached. The light will remember the setting.
Q: How do I switch it on or off?
A: Swipe your hand underneath the light and it will switch ON or OFF.
Q: How does the tumbling work?
A: You can switch on/off the light by giving the tumbler a small push. In between on and off the light might stand still for a short while.
Q: After how long will the light switch off?
A: The light will automatically switch off after 30 minutes.
Q: Can the plush part be washed?
A: Yes, you can remove the plush cover and hand wash it.
Q: How do I change the colour of the light?
A: By pressing the button several times, the colour of the light will change. The light will remember the setting for next use.
Q: Can I switch off the tumble sensor for travel?
A: Yes, if you press the big button for 3 seconds the tumble sensor will be deactivated. By pressing the button again, the light will switch on and the tumble function will work again.
Q: How does Emmy work?
A: Emmy can help your little one to clear the mind by playing calm breathing sound and projecting light on the ceiling getting bigger and smaller. Your little one will automatically focus and follow the calm breathing and pulse light and fall asleep more easily.
Q: How do I turn Emmy on?
A: To switch Emmy on press the round button on the front, between the elephant paws.
Q: How does the 3 step sleep program work?
A: In the first phase the light is bright and orange and blue fish are swimming around the room, together with soothing sound, this to grab the attention of the baby. In phase two the brightness is lower and the orange fish disappear, a more quiet environment. In phase three the waves and fish stop swimming and there is no more sound. The perfect setting to fall asleep.
Q: How long does the cry sensor work?
A: Every time you start a new sleep program the cry sensor will be activated for 12 hours. Please note that you have to switch on the cry sensor on the bottom of the module.
Q: Can the plush cover be washed?
A: Yes, you can hand wash the plush after the module has been removed.
Q: Can I use Cody or Otto without sound?
A: Yes, on the bottom of the module there is a button with music choice, here you can set the switch to OFF.

Q: Can I use Tim without sound?
A: Yes, on the bottom of the module there is a button with music choice, here you can set the switch to OFF.
Q: How do I activate the cry sensor?
A: Set the switch on the bottom in the ON position. The cry sensor will then be active for 12 hours every time to switch Wally on. Depending on the distance to your child, the cry sensor will activate upon crying.
Q: How do I attach Wally to the crib?
A: Use the velcro strap that came with the product. On the bottom of Wally there are loops where you can put the strap.
Q: Can I use Wally without sound?
A: Yes, you can switch off the sound on the bottom with the sound switch.
Q: How do I activate the cry sensor?
A: Press the cry sensor button for 3 seconds. The light will flash green when activated and red when deactivated. The cry sensor will then be active for 12 hours every time to activate the projector. Depending on the distance to your child, the cry sensor will activate upon crying.
Q: Can the plush cover be washed?
A: Yes, you can hand wash the plush after the module has been removed.
Q: Can I use the projector without sound?
A: Yes, if you only press the projection button there will be light only, no sound.
Q: Can I place the bag on a metal rack?
A: It is not advised to place the bag on a metal rack, better to place on a glass plate. Make sure the surface is clean. Take the bag out of the plush animal.
Q: How long does the heat pack stay warm?
A: Depending on how warm it was when started, it should stay warm for around an hour.
Q: Can I use the bag as a coolpack?
A: Yes, you can place the bag in the freezer for a couple of hours and then it will gently cool the area you put it on.
Q: How do I start the play mode?
A: By squeezing the foot with the triangle, the play mode will start. To stop you can press the foot again.
Q: How do I start the sing-a-long mode?
A: By squeezing the foot with the music note, the sing-a-long mode will start. To stop you can press the foot again.
Q: Can I switch off the product completely?
A: Yes, on the bottom of the product there is an ON/OFF switch.

A: Yes, on the bottom of the product there is an ON/OFF switch.
Q: Which melodies can you play?
A: You can play heartbeat sound, nature sounds, white noise and 3 calming melodies.
Q: Can you adjust the volume of the melodies?
A: You can adjust the volume yourself by pressing the volume button up or down.
Q: After how many minutes will the sound turn off?
A: The sound turns off automatically after 10 minutes.

shipping: Every order is picked and dispatched fast from the Coolkidz Australia warehouse in Braeside, Melbourne, on business days, and sent with tracked carriers Australia-wide. warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty on MiaMily luggage bought in Australia from an authorised retailer, for the product's usable life from the original purchase date. Claims: proof of purchase plus photos, lodged through the Coolkidz support portal (https://help.coolkidz.com.au). Coolkidz repairs, replaces, or offers a refund or store credit at its discretion. Customer pays shipping to return for evaluation; Coolkidz covers return shipping if the defect is covered. Non-transferable; sits alongside Australian Consumer Law rights.
returns: Returns follow the store refund policy at https://miamily.com.au/policies/refund-policy Contact Coolkidz support with the order number to start a return.

SAFETY RULES
- Child must be able to sit unassisted
- Always belt the child in (Carry On, Check In, Carry On Plus, Check In Plus have the belt; the Carry On Pro has no child seatbelt and is a gate seat for teens and adults)
- Adult supervision at all times
- Flat surfaces only
- Never on escalators, stairs, travelators or slopes
- 100 kg total capacity including luggage contents
- Brake on before loading on the Plus range

HOW TO RIDE
- Stop on a flat surface and press the wheel brake (Plus range)
- Lift the built-in seat until it locks upright
- Sit the child facing forward and fasten the belt
- Hang the bag on the seat-back hook, extend the handle
- Pull smoothly and stay beside the child

FAQ
Q: What is MiaMily?
A: MiaMily is a Swiss-designed travel and family lifestyle brand founded in 2014 by parents Alessandro Cereda and Cecilia Tsai. It is best known for ride-on luggage: hard-shell suitcases with a patented built-in seat that a child rides on while a parent pulls. In Australia the range is distributed exclusively by Coolkidz Australia.
Q: Where are MiaMily products designed and made?
A: All MiaMily products are designed in Switzerland and responsibly assembled in China, with materials, durability and safety standards overseen by MiaMily.
Q: What makes MiaMily luggage different from a normal suitcase?
A: The built-in seat. It turns the suitcase into a ride-on for kids, a resting seat for adults, a stroller alternative in airports and a hook for your nappy bag. The seat supports up to 100 kg including luggage contents, so it stays useful from toddler to teenager to adult. You also get 360° spinner wheels, a TSA-approved lock, adjustable handle heights, a child safety belt on the Carry On, Check In and Plus models, and a durable polycarbonate hard shell.
Q: Is the ride-on seat safe for children?
A: Yes, within its limits. The luggage has an aluminium frame rated to 100 kg and a wider base for stability, and the Carry On, Check In, Carry On Plus and Check In Plus include a built-in safety belt to secure your child. Children must be able to sit unassisted and should always be supervised by an adult. Use it on flat surfaces only, never on escalators or stairs.
Q: What age can a child ride on MiaMily luggage?
A: MiaMily does not set a minimum age; the rule is that the child must be able to sit unassisted, be belted in, and be supervised. Most families use the ride-on from the toddler years. The 100 kg capacity means older kids and adults can sit on it too.
Q: Does the Carry On Pro have a ride-on seat?
A: The Carry On Pro has a reinforced Sit Ready shell that supports up to 100 kg, so you can sit on it at the gate. It does not include the child seatbelt or the seat-back bag hook of the Carry On, Check In and Plus models, so it suits older kids, teens and adults rather than toddlers.
Q: Can I use the seat as a high chair?
A: The Carry On Plus is designed so the built-in seat doubles as a high chair on the go, with the wheel brake keeping the case still while your child is seated. Always belt your child in and stay with them.
Q: What happens to the seat when I travel without a child?
A: It becomes a bag holder. Hook or stack a nappy bag, tote or briefcase on the seat, or sit on it yourself during long waits.
Q: What are the dimensions and weight of the Carry On?
A: Carry On: 51 × 38 × 29 cm including wheels (20 × 14.9 × 11.4 inches), 4.3 kg, 43 litres. It is the same footprint MiaMily describes as fitting most airline overhead compartments.
Q: What are the dimensions and weight of the Check In?
A: Check In: 66 × 45 × 31 cm including wheels (25.9 × 17.7 × 12.2 inches), 6.5 kg, 77 litres.
Q: Can I bring MiaMily luggage on a plane as cabin baggage?
A: The Carry On size is designed to fit in most airline overhead compartments. Airline cabin policies and weight limits vary, particularly on Australian domestic carriers, so we recommend confirming your carrier's dimensions before flying. The Check In and Check In Plus are checked luggage.
Q: What are the dimensions of the Plus and Pro models?
A: Carry On Plus: 51 × 39 × 30 cm, 4.8 kg, 43 litres. Check In Plus: 65.5 × 46 × 33 cm, 5.9 kg, 77 litres. Carry On Pro: 51 × 39 × 23 cm, 3.5 kg, 48 litres, the lightest and slimmest of the range because it has no ride-on seat mechanism. Figures are as published by MiaMily.
Q: How big is the Expandable Backpack?
A: 44 × 31 × 11 cm, expanding to 22 cm deep. That takes it from 15 litres to 30 litres. It is made from 100% recycled polyester with YKK zips and has 11 pockets, including a laptop pocket, a thermal bottle pocket and an anti-theft passport pocket.
Q: How do I set the TSA lock?
A: Your luggage comes preset to 000. Shift the pin inside the lock from A to B, set your new three-digit code, then move the pin back to A. The lock is TSA-approved and does not come with a key; TSA agents can open it with a universal key if inspection is required.
Q: What is the luggage made of?
A: The suitcases use a polycarbonate hard shell with an anti-scratch texture, a polypropylene built-in seat and a polyester interior lining. The Expandable Backpack is 100% recycled polyester.
Q: How do I clean it?
A: Wipe the shell with a soft damp cloth and mild soap. Avoid solvents and abrasive cleaners, which can dull the textured finish. Let the interior lining air dry fully before packing.
Q: Where does MiaMily Australia ship?
A: We ship the entire range Australia-wide. Carry On luggage and Backpacks also ship to New Zealand. Every order is dispatched fast from the Coolkidz warehouse in Melbourne.
Q: What warranty comes with MiaMily luggage in Australia?
A: Every MiaMily suitcase bought from an authorised Australian retailer is covered by a Limited Lifetime Warranty on manufacturing defects in materials and workmanship, covering zips, handles, wheels, stitching and materials. Wear and tear, cosmetic damage, misuse and airline handling damage are not covered. Claims go through the Coolkidz support portal with proof of purchase.
Q: Where can I see MiaMily luggage in person?
A: MiaMily is stocked by authorised independent baby retailers in VIC, NSW, QLD, SA and WA, and by national retailers including Myer, Harvey Norman, Baby Bunting and Big W. See the stockists page for the full list.
Q: Which model should I buy?
A: Carry On for short trips and one rider. Carry On Plus if you fly often with a toddler and want top-opening packing, a brake and a snack pocket. Check In or Check In Plus for longer holidays and more than one child. Carry On Pro for teens and adults who want a light, front-opening case with a gate seat. The Which MiaMily page walks you through it in four questions.

smarTrike.facts:
RANGE
wonder_shared: The Wonder range (Wonder, Wonder+, Wonder max) is built for everyday use. Every Wonder converts from stroller mode (you push) to trike mode (they hold on, you steer) to training mode (they pedal, you guide) to free riding. Shared: lightweight aluminium frame, 5-point harness, safety bumper bar, patented 360 degree one-handed steering that turns on the spot and reverses, shock-absorbing front wheel, one-foot rear brake, 3-second single-piece fold, carry-on approved, certified to stroller safety standards (not toy standards), 2-year Australian warranty. Australian models include a tether strap and a red brake.
wonder_max: Wonder max: $579 RRP. 6 months to 3 years. 6.95 kg. Folded 54.5 x 26.5 x 38 cm. Seat reclines to 140 degrees, the ONLY model that reclines and the only one suitable under 10 months (babies who cannot sit unaided need the recline). Extra-large premium cushioned seat, 3-stage canopy, colour Stone Beige. Best for naps on the move and starting early.
wonder_plus: Wonder+: $489 RRP. 10 months to 3 years. 6.42 kg. Folded 52 x 25.5 x 41 cm. Extra-large breathable mesh seat, 3-stage canopy, colour Sand. Best for long days in strong sun.
wonder: Wonder: $389 RRP. 10 months to 3 years. 5.9 kg (lightest in the Wonder range). Folded 54 x 25 x 34 cm. Breathable mesh seat, 2-stage canopy, colour Moonlight (white frame, black canopy). Best for travel and short walks.
wind: Wind range is the entry range for occasional and travel use, same patented steering and stroller-standard safety, 2-stage canopy, 10 months to 3 years. Wind: $249.99 RRP, 5.6 kg, colours Aqua, Blush, Black. Wind+: $299.99 RRP, 5.9 kg, Black, low step-in frame, adjustable child handlebar, detachable pedals and footrest. Folded sizes for the Wind range are not published yet; say so and offer the phone number. The Wonder range adds better fabrics, upgraded wheels and a sturdier frame for daily use.
xtend: Xtend is for after the trike, 12 months to 12 years. Xtend Ride-on: $149.99 RRP (was $249.99), parent-controlled ride-on from 12 months, ride-on from 2, converts to a 3-wheel then 2-wheel scooter, colours Blue, Pink, Teal, Cool Grey, Soft green. Xtend Mini+ scooter: $99.99 RRP (was $149.99), 2 to 9 years, the only extendable scooter, colours Green, Pink, Blue, Grey. Weights and dimensions not published; say so.

CHOOSING
Under 10 months: Wonder max only (recline). 10 months to 2 years: any model; naps on the move -> Wonder max; strong sun or long days -> Wonder+; lightest or travel -> Wonder; occasional or holiday use on a budget -> Wind or Wind+. 2 years and up: Wonder or Wonder+ (they pedal more than they are pushed, so the recline matters less). After 3: Xtend.

POLICIES
shipping: Free shipping Australia-wide on every order, no minimum, from the Melbourne warehouse. Business days from dispatch: Melbourne metro 2 to 3; Sydney, Brisbane, Adelaide and Canberra 2 to 5; Perth, Hobart and Darwin 3 to 5; regional and remote 4 to 5. Orders before 10am AEST on a business day usually dispatch the same day. Tracking is emailed at dispatch. Most deliveries need a signature; if nobody is home the carrier leaves a card and takes it to a collection point. No international shipping, no PO boxes.
returns: 30 days from delivery for change of mind. Unused (or assembled only enough to look at), in the original packaging with all parts. Self-service through the Australia Post returns portal. Refund within 5 business days of arrival, to the original payment method. Transit damage: report within 48 hours with photos.
warranty: 2 years on every smarTrike sold in Australia, on top of Australian Consumer Law, no registration needed. Covers manufacturing faults in the frame, steering, brake, folding mechanism, wheels, bearings, shock absorber, harness, buckles, bumper bar, seat fabric and canopy. Not covered: normal wear and tear, misuse, accident, use beyond age or weight limits, modification, outdoor or damp storage damage, second-hand purchases, commercial or hire use. Claims go through the help centre with proof of purchase, model name and photos or a short video. Registering the product means we can reach you about safety updates and process a claim faster.
air_travel: The Wonder range is carry-on approved and designed for the overhead locker. It folds to one piece in three seconds. Cabin allowances vary by airline and fare: always tell the customer to check their airline's allowance against the folded size. Never state an airline's allowance. If it goes in the hold it travels as a stroller.

SAFETY
Certified to stroller safety standards rather than toy standards, with a 5-point harness, safety bumper bar, shock-absorbing front wheel, one-foot rear brake and a fold lock that cannot fold with a child in it. Habits: harness on every time; brake on when stopped; recline only on the Wonder max with the harness done up; keep a hand on the parent handle until they can pedal and brake on purpose; check both fold locks after every fold; register the product.

DEVELOPMENT
General guidance for parents, not clinical advice. 6 to 9 months: sitting with support, needs a reclining seat. 10 to 12 months: sits unaided, holds the handlebar, cannot steer or pedal. 12 to 18 months: walking, scoots with feet on a trike. 18 months to 2 years: finds the pedals, one foot at a time, often backwards first; training mode with the parent handle on. 2 to 3 years: pedals continuously and steers on purpose; free riding, parent handle back on for the tired ride home. For any concern about development, suggest a maternal and child health nurse or GP.

FAQ
Q: Is Mamave safe to use during pregnancy?
A: Yes. every Mamave formula is designed to be pregnancy-safe. Products are developed by a cosmetic chemist who understands pregnancy skin, and avoid retinoids, parabens and synthetic fragrance. If you have specific medical concerns, we always recommend checking with your healthcare professional.
Q: Can I use Mamave products on my newborn?
A: The Bubba range is formulated for babies and young children: pH-balanced for baby skin, with gentle coconut-based cleansers and calming botanicals like calendula, aloe vera and chamomile. One range, head to toe.
Q: Is ‘natural’ skincare the same as pregnancy-safe?
A: No. and that's why Mamave exists. Natural doesn't automatically mean safe for pregnancy or for newborn skin. Mamave goes beyond traditional natural skincare: each product is developed using cosmetic science to support delicate skin at every stage, from pregnancy through to newborn care.
Q: Which skincare ingredients should I avoid while pregnant?
A: The ingredients most commonly avoided during pregnancy are retinoids (vitamin A derivatives), parabens and synthetic fragrance. Every Mamave formula leaves all three out, so you never have to decode a label. And if you're unsure about a product from another brand, your healthcare professional can advise.
Q: Why does my skin change during pregnancy?
A: Hormones. As they shift, skin can become drier, tighter, itchier and more reactive than usual. Hormonal breakouts and new sensitivities are common. That's why pregnancy skincare should be gentler and more supportive than your usual routine, not just the same products with a different label.
Q: Can I use Mamave if I have sensitive skin?
A: Mamave is designed for delicate, reactive skin. Pregnancy skin is sensitive skin. Formulas avoid synthetic fragrance and harsh additives, and many customers use the range on children with sensitive skin. As with any skincare, patch test first and check with your healthcare professional if you have a diagnosed skin condition.
Q: What age can I start using the Bubba range?
A: From newborn. The Bubba range is formulated for newborns, babies and young children: gentle, pH-balanced care for delicate new skin, from the very first bath onward.
Q: What helps protect against nappy rash?
A: Bubba's Barrier Cream. Apply a thick layer to your baby's bottom or other rash-affected areas. Its zinc oxide formula creates a breathable barrier between a wet nappy and delicate skin, protecting against moisture and irritation from rubbing.
Q: What can I use for cradle cap?
A: Bubba's Massage Oil is formulated to gently support cradle cap care. Warm a small amount in your hands and massage gently. Its plant-derived oils with calendula and aloe vera soften and soothe delicate skin.
Q: How do I massage my baby?
A: Warm a small amount of Bubba's Massage Oil by rubbing your hands together, then massage gently into your baby's skin, paying careful attention to their tummy, legs and arms. Daily massage is a beautiful way to turn everyday care into a calming ritual for both of you.
Q: Do I need separate hair and body products for my baby?
A: No. Bubba's Wash is a gentle all-in-one for hair and body. Coconut-based surfactants cleanse mildly, calming calendula soothes, and it's pH-balanced for baby skin. One product, head to toe, every bath.
Q: What ingredients does Mamave avoid?
A: Retinoids, parabens, synthetic fragrance and unnecessary fillers. Formulas are scented naturally with essential oils such as lavender, frankincense and mandarin, and built on plant oils rich in vitamin E and Gamma Linolenic Acid (GLA).
Q: Are Mamave products made in Australia?
A: Yes. Mamave is 100% Australian made and owned, and formulated here by a cosmetic scientist.
Q: What is GLA and why is it in Mamave formulas?
A: GLA (Gamma Linolenic Acid) is a fatty acid found in plant oils like borage seed and evening primrose. It helps support the skin barrier and relieve dryness, which is why you'll find GLA-rich oils across the range, from Mumma's Oil to Bubba's Moisturiser.
Q: What does Mamave use instead of synthetic fragrance?
A: Essential oils, chosen for calm as much as scent: lavender and frankincense in the Mumma range, lavender and ylang ylang in Bubba's Moisturiser and Massage Oil, and naturally derived mandarin in Bubba's Wash.
Q: What's in Mumma's Oil?
A: A blend of plant oils rich in vitamin E and GLA: safflower, sunflower, grape seed, camellia, jojoba, argan and evening primrose, lightly scented with calming lavender and frankincense essential oils. Nothing else.
Q: Why is squalane in Bubba's Moisturiser?
A: Squalane locks in moisture by mimicking the skin's own naturally produced squalene, so it hydrates without feeling heavy: ideal for daily use and gentle baby massage, alongside GLA-rich borage seed oil and soothing calendula.
Q: Which product should I start with?
A: Most mums start with Mumma's Oil, massaged into the belly, hips and thighs up to three times a day to support skin elasticity through pregnancy and postpartum. For bub, Bubba's Wash is the gentle all-in-one for bath time. Bundles are the best-value way to try the full ritual.
Q: What is the bump-to-bub ritual?
A: A simple three-step routine for mum: soak with Mumma's Soak to unwind, massage Mumma's Oil into changing skin, then seal in hydration with Mumma's Moisturiser. When bub arrives, the Bubba range carries the same care through bath time and beyond.
Q: Mumma's Oil vs Mumma's Moisturiser: which do I need?
A: Mumma's Oil is a concentrated massage oil for supporting skin elasticity and the appearance of stretch marks, massaged into the bump, hips and thighs up to three times a day. Mumma's Moisturiser is a daily cream with vitamin C-rich pomegranate and cranberry extracts for everyday hydration. Many mums use both: oil first, moisturiser to seal it in.
Q: Bubba's Moisturiser vs Bubba's Massage Oil: what's the difference?
A: Bubba's Moisturiser is a daily cream: squalane and calendula to hydrate and calm dry skin after the bath. Bubba's Massage Oil is a light plant oil for daily baby massage and cradle cap care. Both are rich in GLA and scented with lavender and ylang ylang.
Q: When should I start using Mumma's Oil?
A: It's designed for use throughout pregnancy and postpartum. Many mums build it into their routine as soon as skin starts stretching, applying up to three times a day to the belly, thighs, hips and bottom.
Q: What makes a good baby shower gift?
A: A Bubba starter set: Bubba's Wash, Bubba's Moisturiser and Bubba's Massage Oil covers bath time, daily hydration and massage. Build it as a bundle, or let them choose with a Mamave digital gift card ($30, $200).
Q: Do you offer free shipping?
A: Yes. free standard shipping on orders over $75 within Australia.
Q: How do Mamave gift cards work?
A: They're digital: delivered by email, in values from $30 to $200, and redeemable across the full Mamave range. Ideal for baby showers and new-mum gifts.
Q: Are bundles better value than buying separately?
A: Yes. bundling is the best-value way to shop the ritual. Build your own bundle of three or more products and the bundle saving applies automatically.
Q: Who formulates Mamave products?
A: Georgie, Mamave's founder: a cosmetic development chemist with a degree in Pharmaceutical Science and over ten years' experience working closely with children. She began developing the first formulas in 2021, and every product is developed with cosmetic chemists, scientists and naturopaths, then crafted in small batches in Australia.
Q: Are Mamave products vegan and cruelty-free?
A: Yes. the range is vegan and cruelty-free, with no parabens, mineral oils, almond or peanut oils, and completely SLS and SLES free (Sodium Lauryl Sulphate and Sodium Laureth Sulphate).
Q: What if a product isn't right for us?
A: Mamave offers a 30-day money-back guarantee. If you're not completely happy with your purchase, they'll make it right.

A: Choose your favourites, pick a delivery rhythm that suits you, and they arrive on repeat with a subscriber saving on every order, so the ritual never runs out mid-bump. Checkout is handled securely by Shopify, and you stay in control the whole time.

INGREDIENTS
- name: ACACIA SENEGAL GUM & XANTHAN GUM
about: Acacia Senegal Gum is a natural thickener derived from Acacia trees in sub-Saharan Africa. It helps improve the smooth feel and viscosity of skincare formulations. Xanthan Gum is a naturally derived thickening agent produced through sugar fermentation. It helps stabilise emulsions and gives our moisturisers and cleansers their gel-like consistency. While it doesn’t directly benefit the skin, it plays an important role in creating products that feel luxurious and easy to apply (because nobody wants a watery moisturiser).
- name: ALOE VERA
about: Aloe Vera extract is derived from the succulent Aloe Vera plant. It is well known for its soothing properties and its ability to calm skin inflammation, redness and irritation.
- name: APRICOT KERNEL OIL
about: Apricot Kernel Oil is cold-pressed from apricot seeds, producing a rich golden oil. It is valued for its nourishing and softening properties and its ability to absorb deeply into the skin.
- name: ARGAN OIL
about: Pressed from the kernels of Moroccan Argan trees, Argan Oil is rich in Vitamin E and essential fatty acids. It deeply moisturises both skin and hair, helping to soften dry areas and improve overall skin texture.
- name: BENTONITE
about: Bentonite is a mineral-rich clay known for its absorbent properties. It helps draw excess oil and impurities from the skin and is believed to have a calming effect.
- name: BENZYL ALCOHOL & DEHYDROACETIC ACID
about: This preservative system is free from parabens, isothiazolinones and formaldehyde. Benzyl alcohol occurs naturally in some essential oils. Together, these ingredients help protect products from bacteria, mould and fungal growth. BIS-DIGLYCERYL POLYACYLADIPATE-2 (Vegan Lanolin)
- name: BIS-DIGLYCERYL POLYACYLADIPATE-2 (Vegan Lanolin)
about: A plant-derived alternative to lanolin, this ingredient enhances glide and improves spreadability. It also forms a protective barrier on the skin to help lock in moisture.
- name: BORAGE SEED OIL
about: Derived from Borago officinalis, Borage Seed Oil is rich in Gamma Linolenic Acid (GLA), known for its anti-inflammatory properties. Research has shown it may help support the skin barrier in conditions such as cradle cap, which is why it features in our For Bub range.
- name: CALENDULA EXTRACT
about: Extracted from marigold flowers, Calendula is rich in antioxidants and Vitamin C. It helps soothe irritated skin and support hydration, making it ideal for sensitive skin formulas.
- name: CAMELLIA SEED OIL
about: Sourced from Camellia oleifera, this lightweight oil is rich in Vitamins A, B and E, as well as zinc and squalene. It absorbs quickly and leaves skin feeling smooth and hydrated.
- name: CAPRYLYL/CAPRYL GLUCOSIDE
about: A gentle, plant-derived surfactant that helps oils and water blend together. It enhances foaming in cleansers while remaining mild on the skin. CAPRYLIC/CAPRIC TRIGLYCERIDES (MCT Oil)
- name: CAPRYLIC/CAPRIC TRIGLYCERIDES (MCT Oil)
about: Derived from coconut oil and glycerine, this lightweight emollient improves spreadability and helps prevent moisture loss.
- name: CASTOR SEED OIL
about: Extracted from castor beans, this thick oil is rich in ricinoleic acid. It provides moisturising, soothing and anti-inflammatory benefits, making it ideal for barrier creams.
- name: CETEARYL ALCOHOL & CETEARYL GLUCOSIDE
about: Cetearyl Alcohol is a fatty alcohol that thickens and stabilises creams while improving skin feel. Unlike drying alcohols, it helps soften skin. Cetearyl Glucoside is a naturally derived emulsifier that allows oil and water to combine smoothly. Together, they form an effective oil-in-water emulsifying system.
- name: CITRIC ACID
about: Naturally found in citrus fruits, Citric Acid helps adjust product pH to support the skin’s natural barrier function.
- name: COCAMIDOPROPYL BETAINE
about: A coconut-derived surfactant used in cleansers to gently remove dirt and impurities while enhancing lather.
- name: CRANBERRY EXTRACT

Q: How does the gel applicator work?
A: Squeeze a pea-sized amount of your usual teething gel onto the textured bumps on the back of the monkey's head, hand it over, and let bub chew. The bumps massage the gel onto the gums, including the hard-to-reach back molars, with no gel on fingers or faces.

Q: How do I clean and sterilise it?

FAQ
Q: What is the Hannie Portable High Chair?
A: A space-saving high chair for children from around 6 months to 5 years that attaches securely to a standard adult dining chair. It folds flat, weighs about 2 kg packed, and comes with a protective tote bag so it travels anywhere you do.
Q: From what age can my baby use it?
A: From around 6 months, once your baby has good head and neck control and can sit with support. Those are the same readiness signs used for starting solids. It then converts to a toddler seat and lasts to around 5 years (25 kg maximum).
Q: How long will it last?
A: From roughly 6 months to 5 years. In Baby Chair mode (with the Reversible Cushion, harness and tray) it supports up to 15 kg; converted to Toddler Seat mode it supports up to 25 kg.
Q: Can it replace a traditional high chair?
A: For most families, yes. It puts your child at the family table using a chair you already own, then converts as they grow, without a bulky frame taking up floor space. See our comparison of seat types for an honest look at where each option wins.
Q: Do I need the Reversible Cushion?
A: The cushion gives younger babies extra comfort and support, and its ergonomic Back Plate Support adds stability while they're still learning to sit through a meal. As your child grows you simply remove it.
Q: Is the Hannie Portable High Chair safe?
A: Yes. It's tested to EN 16120:2012+A2:2017 (the European chair-mounted seat standard), AS/NZS 8124.3, CPN No. 11 and US FDA 21 CFR requirements. Always read the manual, fit the 3-point harness, and supervise your child during use.
Q: What kind of dining chair should I attach it to?
A: A sturdy four-legged chair with a firm, flat seat and a high backrest. The seat needs to be at least 38 cm wide, 35 cm deep and 30 cm high. Avoid stools, swivel chairs, folding chairs and soft, padded seats. Try our interactive fit guide to check your chairs.
Q: Can I use it on the floor or in the bath?
A: No. It's designed only for secure attachment to an adult dining chair. Never use it freestanding on the floor, on a table, or in wet environments.
Q: What is the weight limit?
A: Up to 15 kg in Baby Chair mode and up to 25 kg in Toddler Seat mode.
Q: How much does it weigh?
A: About 2 kg packed, including the Reversible Cushion, which is light enough to carry to a café, a restaurant, or the grandparents' place without thinking twice.
Q: Does it fit under a pram?
A: Yes. Packed in its tote bag it fits under most stroller baskets, so it can come along to brunch, holidays and weekends away.
Q: How quickly does it set up?
A: It attaches to a dining chair in well under a minute once you've done it a couple of times. Watch the 60-second setup video to see the whole process.
Q: Is the tray dishwasher-safe?
A: Yes. The tray is food-safe and dishwasher-safe on a gentle cycle at 50 to 60°C, or you can simply wipe it with a damp cloth. The seat and seat support shouldn't go in the dishwasher.
Q: How do I clean the seat?
A: Wipe the seat and seat support with a damp cloth after meals. For stubborn stains, use warm water and a mild detergent.
Q: Can I machine-wash the cushion and harness?
A: Yes. The Reversible Cushion washes on a gentle cycle at up to 40°C. Always remove the Back Plate Support first, skip dry cleaning, and tumble dry low. The harness is machine washable at 40°C in a laundry bag, without tumble drying.
Q: Is the Hannie Portable High Chair sustainable?
A: It's designed around the idea of fewer, better baby products: one chair replaces the high chair, travel seat and booster you'd otherwise buy, it's built to serve to 25 kg, and it's 100% recyclable by the end user at the end of its life.
Q: Can it be handed down to a second child or sold on?
A: Yes, that's the point of building it to last. Every part wipes or machine-washes clean, the seat is rated to 25 kg, and the 2-year warranty even transfers to second-hand owners with proof of purchase.
Q: What happens when my child outgrows it?
A: Pass it on to a sibling, a friend, or the second-hand market, where the transferable warranty keeps it genuinely useful. If it's truly at the end of its life, it's 100% recyclable by the end user.
Q: What warranty does it come with?
A: A 2-year warranty from the original purchase date, honoured in Australia by Coolkidz Australia, the exclusive authorised distributor. It covers manufacturing faults under normal use, for original and second-hand owners with proof of purchase.
Q: How do I make a warranty claim?
A: Lodge a ticket at help.coolkidz.com.au with your proof of purchase, a description of the issue and photos or video. Approved claims are repaired, replaced, refunded or credited.
Q: Who sells Hannie in Australia?
A: Hannie is sold online at hannie.com.au and distributed exclusively by Coolkidz Australia Pty Ltd (Braeside, VIC), the family behind UPPAbaby, Frida, Nanit and other premium baby brands in Australia. Retailers can apply to become a stockist via the Coolkidz support portal.
Q: Is a chair-mounted seat as safe as a freestanding high chair?
A: Used correctly, yes. Chair-mounted seats have their own dedicated safety standard, EN 16120, covering the attachment system, restraint and stability, and the Hannie is tested to it (plus AS/NZS 8124.3). The two rules that matter everywhere: a sturdy four-legged chair underneath, and the harness clipped every time.
Q: What age is a booster seat suitable for?
A: Plain boosters generally suit children from around 12 months who can sit confidently unaided, as they add height rather than support. The Hannie covers that stage too: its Toddler Seat mode is a booster rated to 25 kg, but it starts earlier, from around 6 months, with cushion and harness.
Q: Do fabric travel high chairs have a tray?
A: Rarely. Most fabric or clip-style travel seats hold your child at the table edge and rely on the table itself. The Hannie packs almost as small but includes a food-safe, dishwasher-safe tray, so your child has their own surface anywhere.
Q: Which seat is best for a small apartment?
A: A chair-mounted seat wins on floor space: it uses a dining chair you already own and packs to about 2 kg in a tote, so there's no bulky frame to park in a corner. A traditional high chair suits homes with room to leave it standing.
